descriptions.d24l_key_border_802c7e20: When the +64 border is not loaded and both +108 and +68 are set, runs 0x802c7f60, loads 'FE.K.KeyBdr' with resource type base+31 (or base+32 when +84 is set) through a handle constructed from the name, stores the cast mesh retained at +64, stores byte value 9 on it (0x80173f88) and attaches it to the +28 object through virtual slot +92. Always finishes with the panel vector update 0x802c7d24.
